meta_verdict: The in-kernel Weil criterion changes the Wall's coordinates, not its content: the positivity clause becomes F(c, lam) >= 0 on the (height, resolution) quarter-plane; every bounded rectangle is certifiable at explicit cost; the residual is the infinite-height diagonal lam >= lam_res(c). No new foothold. Open lemmas: effective O2 (S3), BL admissibility dictionary (S5). One transfer: AF bandwidth (S4).

seams.claim: RH <=> forall c, forall lam > 0, F(c, lam) >= 0 (two-parameter family reduction)
seams.mechanism: Forward: on-line zeros contribute x^2 e^{-2 lam x^2} >= 0, summable. Converse: contrapositive of gaussian_dominance plus rh_of_all_on_line.
seams.limitation: An equivalence: relocates the wall from the C_c^infinity cone to the (c, lam) quarter-plane. Zero-side form mentions no primes; prime-side form needs the Gaussian explicit formula (P2).
seams.what_transfer_buys: Coordinates for the Wall: c = height, lam = resolution. Kernel-derivable today.

seams.claim: Region picture: envelope/small-lam region unconditional; ladder region from certified zeros; residual = Wall
seams.mechanism: Envelope: archimedean integral ~ log(c/2pi) sqrt(pi)/(4 pi (2 lam)^{3/2}) beats absolute prime sum ~ P(lam) f(0), P(lam) ~ e^{lam/2} sqrt(8 pi lam); threshold c_1(lam) ~ 2 pi exp(2 P(lam)), doubly exponential in lam = Zhu T_1(L) = 2 pi e^{A_L} under L_eff = lam/2 + (1/2) log(2 pi lam). Ladder: uncertified tail bounded by e^{2 lam (1/4 - D^2)} times the summable majorant; D ~ 1-2 for lam >= 1.
seams.limitation: Envelope region never looks at the zero side (zero content). Ladder region factors through certified on-line zeros (B4: near-true by construction; cross-island). Residual: T - D < c < c_1(lam) for lam > lam_1(T) ~ 2 log log T (0.7 at 6.4e5, 1.6 at 3e12).

refutation.single_axis: REFUTED: mechanism identical to Yoshida / Connes-Consani Thm 1 / Zhu Lemma 3.1 (archimedean dominance)
refutation.literature: Zhu abstract and CC PDF read; consistent

seams.claim: Prime-side certification bandwidth; feasible lam; is it the Landau-Widom/Zhu barrier
seams.as_foothold: COLLAPSE_TO_FREE (dominated by the Turing ladder at every feasible height)
seams.mechanism: Adjudicated the prompt's formula exp(sqrt(8 lam log(1/eps))): it omits the e^{u/2} weight (Lambda(n) n^{-1/2} against ~n density). Tail beyond log X = U is ~ e^{lam/2} e^{-(U - 2 lam)^2/(8 lam)}; margin ~ x1^2 e^{-2 lam x1^2}; hence log X ~ 2 lam (1 + sqrt(1 + 4 x1^2 + 2 log(C/x1^2)/lam)) ~ (4 + O(x1^2)) lam.
seams.feasible_lam: <= 6-7 by prime count; precision is not a barrier (cancellation e^{lam/2 + 2 lam x1^2})
seams.landau_widom_in_these_coordinates: Not in the cost sense: a point certificate is singly exponential in cost and margin (Zhu's doubly-exponential matrix and Landau-Widom margin collapse belong to the cone). It enters through resolution: lam_res(c) = (log(c/2pi))^2/(4 pi^2) to resolve one zero (1.4 at 1e4, 3.4 at 6.4e5, 18.7 at 3e12), and through the certified-resolution law lam_1(T) ~ 2 log log T.
seams.limitation: With lam <= 6-7 the instrument resolves individual zeros only below c ~ 3e7; combined cost per height X ~ c^{log c / pi^2}, super-polynomial, vs c^{1+o(1)} for direct verification.

seams.claim: O2 as a prime-side zero-localisation instrument: certified F >= 0 for lam <= Lambda near c => no off-line zero with |1/2 - beta| >= y_0(Lambda)
seams.mechanism: Pair term at c = t0 is -2 y^2 e^{2 lam y^2}; competes with the window sum of on-line terms x_j^2 e^{-2 lam x_j^2} and with other off-line terms whose phase cos(2 arg w_j - 4 lam x_j y_j) turns positive near x_j ~ pi/(4 lam y).
seams.limitation: The implication is not a theorem: gaussian_dominance produces lam >= max(1, A/(2 eta K), B/(2 M K)) with eta (gap), A, B configuration-dependent and non-effective; the crude absolute bound fails once the window holds >= 2 other zeros. An effective O2 needs short-range zero-clustering control at scale 1/(Lambda y_0) (pair-correlation territory; unconditional input is only the O(log t) unit-window count). Candidate attack: average over lam in [Lambda/2, Lambda]; unproven. Even granted, the ladder certifies exactly at every feasible height.

refutation.single_axis: REFUTED as a foothold: dominated by direct verification wherever feasible

seams.claim: Alpoge-Furman transfer: sharper proportion from a better window or from the exact off-line pair phase
seams.mechanism: AF compress Weil's form to a finite Gram matrix over tests of Fourier support [-1,1], evaluate tr and ||.||_F^2 on the prime side by Montgomery-Vaughan (diagonal dominance, X <= T), apply rank-trace with Sylvester inertia.
seams.why_corpus_pieces_cannot_help: tr and Frobenius norm are unitarily invariant; an off-line pair block has signature (1,1) whatever its phase; the phase 2 arg w - 4 lam x y is basis-dependent and invisible to any rank-trace certificate by construction.
seams.ceiling: Zeta23.PairCeiling.ceiling_law256: every bandwidth-one certificate certifies at most 0.6818287 + 2.55e-6 (|r'(1)| + int |r''|); Montgomery-Taylor window 0.6725 is within 0.009 of the cap.
seams.what_lies_beyond: AF 7.2(a): X >> T needs prime-pair information; 7.3: Montgomery form factor on (-lambda_0, lambda_0) for all lambda_0 would give 100 percent; 7.2(e-f): higher moments unavailable unconditionally. In Gaussian coordinates bandwidth one is lam <~ log T/4, far below lam_res(T) ~ (log T)^2/(4 pi^2): bandwidth-one windows average ~log T zeros, giving proportions never a named zero.
seams.open_lemma: Unconditional prime-side evaluation of a compressed Weil form with Fourier support [-lambda_0, lambda_0], lambda_0 > 1 (equivalently Montgomery F(alpha, T) for 1 < alpha <= lambda_0), or of tr(A^3).

seams.claim: Li face: li_criterion_rh_iff derivable in-kernel through a direct Weil -> Li dictionary
seams.li_criterion_rh_iff_status: PROVED upstream (LiCriterion pin 35df682f), axiom-guarded on the li_positivity island; referenced in docs/LI_POSITIVITY_LADDER.md, examples/li_positivity/lean/RvMRouteP.lean
seams.mechanism: Composition Li <-> RH <-> Weil is vacuous (roadmap section 1) and is a two-island statement. Direct dictionary needs the explicit formula on BL's non-compact g_n (Tannery limit as in O1', majorant n^2/|rho|^2) and whether the Weil -> Li direction uses autocorrelation-type tests (unverified; BL 1999 paywalled).
seams.non_vacuous_finite_content: Localized vs global detectors: a zero at (t, y) needs Li index n ~ t^2/y at ~n bits (cubic cost) vs Gaussian lam ~ log(1/y)/x1^2 at c ~ t with primes to e^{4 lam}. At t = 1e12: n ~ 1e24 vs ~1e10 primes. Instrument fact only. Non-effective inter-conversion holds through existence of an off-line zero; effective map blocked by Freitas delocalization.
seams.kernel_probe: none until BL primary is read; toolchain reconcile is the prerequisite for any composition

seams.claim: Connes-Consani archimedean positivity and the small-lam region are the same foothold
seams.cc_theorem_1_verified: g in C_c^infinity, support [2^{-1/2}, 2^{1/2}], hat g(i/2) = hat g(0) = 0: W_infinity(g * g^*) >= Tr(theta(g) S theta(g)^*); at this support rational primes are not involved. Corollary 2: c |hat g(0)|^2 + Sum_S hat g(s) conj hat g(s) >= Tr(...), 13 < c < 17 (as if zeta were multiplied by (z - 1/2)^17).
seams.mechanism: Same archimedean-dominance foothold: prime side empty (CC, Yoshida) or negligible (Gaussian small lam / large c). Half-width (log 2)/2 = Yoshida's range, corroborated by Bombieri 2000 abstract and Zhu abstract.
seams.limitation: Does no work on zeros. Neither coordinate system extends past the prime threshold except by certified computation (Zhu L = 0.8). Prolate papers (Connes-Moscovici 2112.05500) are spectral realization, not positivity extension.
seams.erratum_note: Roadmap B9 cites the CC range as 2L <= log 2 without the vanishing conditions hat g(i/2) = hat g(0) = 0 that CC Theorem 1 carries; minor.

seams.claim: c -> infinity asymptotics of F with the RvM density
seams.mechanism: Integral over c of the pair term is independent of y (contour shift of an entire Gaussian-type integrand): c-average of F = N sqrt(pi)/(2 (2 lam)^{3/2}) regardless of real parts. The ordinate sweep's reflection-blindness in Gaussian coordinates.

seams.claim: The phase term 4 lam x y is an asymmetric coupling in the capstone's sense
seams.mechanism: Pair term is even in y; the family lies inside the Weil class and re-symmetrizes (fails clause 3); it yields an equivalence, not an unconditional statement (fails clause 1). It is a joint (x, y) coupling: the capped joint axis.

seams.claim: Diagonal-wall geometry: resolution curve vs certified resolution
seams.mechanism: lam_res(c) = (log(c/2pi))^2/(4 pi^2) to resolve one zero at height c; certified resolution from a ladder of height T is lam_1(T) ~ 2 log log T (c_1(lam_1) = T with c_1(lam) ~ 2 pi exp(2 P(lam))). The gap widens without bound: 0.7 vs 3.4 at 6.4e5; 1.6 vs 18.7 at 3e12.
